description: TypeScript provides gradual typing similar to mypy, where any type can be used to opt out of static checking.

steps.description: Typed function: add(x: number, y: number): number enforces numeric arguments.
Type error: add('a', 3) fails because string is not assignable to number.
Any opt-out: x: any = [] silences all checks, x.foo() produces no error.

title: TypeScript: Gradual Typing
